# Beehiiv

Beehiiv is a newsletter platform for managing publications, subscribers, posts, automations, audience engagement, and monetization.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/beehiiv/.

## Actions

- **Create Draft Post**: Create an unscheduled draft post from HTML content.
- **Create Segment**: Create an audience segment from explicit subscription IDs, explicit emails, or custom-field rules.
- **Create Subscription**: Create a new publication subscription without reactivating an unsubscribed address or sending a welcome email.
- **List Custom Fields** (read-only): List the custom-field definitions available for subscriber metadata and dynamic audience segments in a publication, returning one page…
- **List Posts** (read-only): Search a publication's posts by status, audience, channel, slug, tags, or author and optionally include content, recipients, or statistics.
- **List Publications** (read-only): List publications accessible to the API key, optionally including publication statistics.
- **List Segment Members** (read-only): List full subscriber records currently included in an audience segment, optionally including stats, custom fields, referrals, tags, or…
- **List Segments** (read-only): List audience segments in a publication, filtered by segment type or calculation status, with optional latest statistics.
- **List Subscriptions** (read-only): Search a publication's subscriptions by exact email or filter by status and tier, returning one cursor-controlled page of subscriber…
- **Update Draft Post**: Update content or presentation settings on an existing draft after verifying it is still a draft.
- **Update Subscription Custom Fields**: Set or remove custom-field values on one subscription without changing its email, tier, billing link, or subscribed status.
